first_fold_gate.note: The diagonal-rank feature was admitted in both first-fold fitted models but did not change either first-fold prediction. The predeclared gate therefore allowed continuation because neither variant degraded by 0.03 or more.

decision.reason: The training-only diagonal-rank prior passed its predeclared no-fit information-value gate, but adding it to either matched fitted representation reduced the pooled official metric. Do not tune or expand this fitted rank-prior family unchanged. Preserve the negative transfer result and move to a distinct feature mechanism.

operational_notes: A first execution attempt stopped before fitting because the isolated checkout lacked private data and parent artifacts; the root cause was diagnosed before retry.
A second execution attempt stopped before fitting because the isolated checkout lacked the private aggregate market-path report required to verify the sealed parent; no unchanged retry was made.
The successful isolated runtime mounted private data, parent artifact directories, and aggregate comparison reports without modifying the original working copy.
The first-fold gate fit two models and uploaded exact checkpoints. The full continuation reused those two checkpoints and fit only the remaining four models.
The successful full continuation completed in about 80 seconds of lifecycle time, with 73 seconds inside the study stages, and all six saved models replayed exactly.
The SageMaker app was stopped after completion; the temporary lifecycle configuration was deleted and the persistent 50 GB space was retained. IAM was not broadened.
limitations: These are repeatedly inspected development folds, not final-test or leaderboard scores.
The no-fit structural prior passing its gate did not imply that the fitted models would benefit; the matched fitted ablation is the relevant transfer test.
Conditional and simultaneous uncertainty intervals condition on the fitted models and do not undo adaptive feature research.
The final 247 origins remain untouched and no Kaggle submission was made.
